steps: Chrome MCP: find an existing tab on skool.com (this community). If none is open, ask the user to open and join the community first.
For each course tile: click in, enumerate sections and lessons.

For each lesson page: capture the title, video URL (if any), and external links in the description / attachments panel. Pay special attention to drive.google.com, github.com, dropbox.com, gumroad.com, and raw file URLs (.pdf, .json, .csv, .xlsx).
For Google Drive folder URLs: use the embeddedfolderview trick (existing pattern in extract_all.py) to list contents without login.
For direct file URLs: download to raw/{resource-slug}/{filename}.
Append a row per resource to resource_manifest.csv with columns: course, lesson, resource_title, original_url, local_path, kind.
When done: re-run build_wiki.py and report what was added.
caveats: If the community requires payment, skip and mark as 'paid' in the manifest.
Skool lesson attachments sometimes render inside iframes; Chrome MCP may need to evaluate the DOM rather than follow anchor hrefs.
Respect Skool's terms; scrape only content you can already see as a joined member.
